marad_current_advisory.issuer_stated_context: Supersedes 2026-006. Says Houthis resumed attacks and continue posing a threat; cites M/T AMZAN and DAISY reportedly struck off Yanbu on Aug24 (outside target week). It describes elevated risk and possible hostile tactics, especially for specified vessel associations, and advises U.S.-flagged commercial vessels to consider AIS off unless the Master believes that compromises safety, remain as far from Yemen coast as safely possible, and stay vigilant. This is standing regional risk guidance, not a report of a new Oct12–18 Bab transit incident.

ukmto_search_leads.coverage: One batched search with two targeted primary-domain queries. Search-result snippets (not archived source bodies): UKMTO #176 listed Oct17 at 140 NM southwest of Al Mukalla, Yemen; snippet says an LNG tanker reported a skiff with seven persons fired two shots and armed security fired warning shots, after which skiff altered course. Gulf of Aden location is not stated as Bab Strait; any route impact is not established. UKMTO #177 appears as an Oct18 attack listing, but returned snippet did not expose location/details. Treat both as leads pending direct incident-page verification, not a complete incident audit.
